digest.component_or_area: event metrics derivation (agent-process metrics over durable ticket event store)
propositions: Implement read-only metric derivations over the durable event store that reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event) to handle chronological ordering and compaction-retired events without reinventing file handling.

Metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts_per_ticket, rework_within_days, reopen_recovery) must read raw event files and track distinct claim sessions or status transitions; compiled state alone is insufficient because it preserves only the terminal value.

Metrics requiring only terminal facts (first_pass_rate via absence of last_reopened_at, revert_recovery via reverts[] list contents) read compiled state from reduce_ticket for simplicity and correctness.
The metric registry must distinguish Unavailable (empty range returns None) from measured zero (populated range with no qualifying events returns 0).
Revert recovery must filter by target_event_type to count only substantive reverts (STATUS, COMMITS) and exclude reverts of COMMENT/LINK events.

Unit tests must directly craft raw event files with known timestamps and sessions to verify that a two-session ticket yields attempts_per_ticket==2, a closed→open→closed 3-day transition counts in rework_within_days(7) but not 10-day, and retired events are still counted.
